summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the 'Apri Mappa' (dashboard card -> /network-status?view=map&client=<id>) feature on the public preview URL. Logged in as admin info@86bit.it with the mandatory 2FA flow via UI (login -> /2fa-setup, secret read from data-testid=2fa-copy-secret, TOTP computed with stdlib hmac/hashlib -> confirm; subsequent logins via /2fa + verify-2fa using db totp_secret). ALL 6 requested behaviours VERIFIED OK: (1) login+2FA reaches dashboard-page; (2) card 86BIT_Office exposes data-testid=open-map-da3d6e40-... with text 'Apri Mappa' (only inside the EXPANDED card panel - see minor issue); (3) click navigates to /network-status?view=map&client=da3d6e40-b3e5-4d46-9787-dde328a3aa36, page opens with MAP toggle active (indigo) and LIST inactive, NetworkMap renders only the 86BIT_Office group (Internet/WAN -> Zyxel USG Test 192.168.1.254 -> Vendor-Details-Test 192.168.1.3); the other groups '86bit-office' and 'test-client' (and device 10.100.61.34) are NOT rendered; (4) data-testid=client-filter-banner visible with text 'Vista filtrata sul cliente: 86BIT_Office'; (5) data-testid=clear-client-filter navigates to /network-status?view=map, banner disappears, map view stays active and all 3 client tabs (86BIT_Office, 86bit-office, test-client) reappear; (6) Lista/Mappa toggle works while filtered: LIST shows only client-group-da3d6e40-... with its 2 devices, switching back to Mappa keeps the filter. Deep-link /network-status?view=map&client=<id> loaded directly also opens in map view with the banner.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Apri Mappa' is rendered ONLY inside the expanded card panel (Quick actions, DashboardPage.js:412). The spec says 'ogni card cliente mostra un pulsante Apri Mappa' - on the collapsed card only 'Apri' (open-client) is visible, so the feature is not discoverable without expanding. Consider surfacing it in the always-visible header or documenting the expand step.

The card expand/collapse header div (DashboardPage.js:274-292) has no data-testid; tests must click the inner <h3> (clicking the card container does nothing). Add data-testid="client-card-header-<id>" or "expand-client-<id>".

With an unknown/stale client id (?client=nonexistent-xyz) the banner prints the raw id ('Vista filtrata sul cliente: nonexistent-xyz') and the page shows 'Nessun dispositivo monitorato'. Graceful, but a friendlier fallback (e.g. 'Cliente non trovato' or auto-clearing the filter) would be better.

issues: 'Mostra tutti i clienti' button (bg-white/5 + text-[var(--text-muted)]) is very low contrast against the teal banner and looks disabled; use a teal/brighter foreground.
In filtered map view the client tab badge shows '3' while the group header/list report 2 devices (badge appears to count the synthetic Internet/WAN node) - slightly confusing count.

action_items: OPTIONAL: expose 'Apri Mappa' on the collapsed client card (currently only in the expanded panel)
OPTIONAL: add data-testid to the client card expand header for testability
OPTIONAL: improve contrast of the 'Mostra tutti i clienti' button and the unknown-client banner fallback
critical_code_review_comments: ClientStatusPage.js: viewMode is initialised from searchParams only at mount (useState(searchParams.get('view')...)). It works today because clear-client-filter navigates within the same mounted component, but any external navigation that only changes ?view= (e.g. a future link) will NOT update the view. Consider syncing viewMode with searchParams in a useEffect or driving it from the URL.
ClientStatusPage.js is ~940 lines (page + inline detail component) - split into smaller modules per the file-size guideline.
